signal.assumption: Symmetric LONG threshold is an unvalidated hypothesis fixed before future outcomes; not selected from returns.
signal.causality: exchange_ns <= received_ns <= available_ns <= grid_slot_ns; all 289 rows and all 18 symbols; maximum quote age 120s; missing data invalidates slot; ignore rows after decision slot; no retroactive entry.
signal.identity: Price-only causal input digest distinct from raw receipt provenance; arm, slot, producer version and causal digest identify the decision.

execution.adverse_tick_rounding: BUY rounds up; SELL rounds down

costs.entry: VWAP over at most five visible levels, then adverse slippage and price-tick rounding; fee on executed notional.
costs.short_price_rounding: SELL proceeds round downward after adverse slippage; BUY close cost rounds upward.

stress.comparison: Same primary admitted opportunity times and frozen intended quantities, no new or retrospectively selected opportunity. No daily cap or cooldown in either scenario. Stress recomputes depth/freshness, its own exposure/loss caps and exits. Prior stress position or pending intent still open suppresses that opportunity. Report divergence, missing entries and realized exposure separately; no stress PnL for unobserved inputs.

costs.budget_exclusion: The 28bps planning stress allowance excludes observed spread/depth, adverse price movement and funding; it is a sizing convention, not an all-in bound.

execution.stress: Independent exposure and exits per arm, primary admitted opportunities of that arm only; 1000ms latency, 12bps fee and 2bps slippage; debit funding x2, credit zero. No forced matched fills.
execution.end_of_horizon: Both arms require latest modeled entry plus six-hour hold and own entry/exit latency and wait to fit before T1. No new risk after T1; protective residual exits continue and remain reported.

sizing.formula: N=min(0.10*E,0.0025*E/0.0128,0.010*P); abs(q)=floor(N/P/0.001)*0.001; LONG positive, SHORT negative
sizing.entry_revalidation: Only reduce frozen quantity, including post-fee equity cap; never increase to meet minima; same formula in both arms.

research_contract.historical_unit_conversion: UNQUALIFIED; the assumed mapping is part of the synthetic simulator, not a finding about July-October raw sizes.
research_contract.real_metadata_switch: No silent conversion to exchange-faithful mode. Verified applicable metadata would require a new explicit contract/version.
research_contract.margin: Virtual fully cash-backed linear exposure; gross<=10% equity, no leverage, no exchange liquidation emulation.

risk.opposite_signal: Log and suppress while position or intent exists; do not close or reverse solely on opposite signal. Next strictly later grid slot after confirmed flat may enter.
risk.accounting: Fees, signed open PnL and funding included; missing data or funding blocks entries. Daily UTC baseline and persistent all-time high water; daily halt clears only natural UTC rollover with complete accounting; drawdown halt persists pending review.

exits.long: Fresh bid <= entry*0.99: stop; bid >= entry*1.02: take profit; SELL later book after latency.
exits.short: Fresh ask >= entry*1.01: stop; ask <= entry*0.98: take profit; BUY later book after latency.
exits.time: Six hours from actual fill; stop has precedence over time; time over take profit.
exits.latching: Exit intent remains pending through recovery or missing book; partial protective reductions preserve remainder and generation; never increase or invert.

funding.positive_rate: LONG pays; SHORT receives; negative rate reverses cashflow
funding.calendar: Observed contract events, no fixed eight-hour assumption; receipt availability must precede use.
funding.boundary: Within +/-60s of settlement, compute signed cashflows over quantities before and after ALL protective fills, including negative SELL fills closing LONG; select least favourable and preserve bounds. Never delay exits to avoid funding.
funding.reconciliation: Preserve effective_at and observed_at, no rewriting old curve points; once per account, contract and settlement; no new entry with unresolved exposure.

comparison.t0_rule: Next UTC midnight after explicit activation and qualification of exact paired runtime bundle; both new arms start flat together. No backdated PnL. Existing SHORT account remains running and read-only context.
comparison.primary: Difference in total net account PnL (LONG_SHORT minus SHORT_CONTROL) across the complete identical 90-day window including zero-trade weeks; no selection of jointly filled trades.
secondary: signal count, blocked/missed/filled and reasons per direction
LONG occupancy suppressing later SHORT opportunities
weekly paired return differences including partial and zero-trade weeks
comparison.fairness: Same raw causal receipts, cutoffs, costs, initial equity and risk formulas, independent state and exits. Equal cost schedule does not imply equal total costs, exposure or realised risk.
comparison.existing_account_context: May show its net return over same window with explicit starting equity and positions; different legacy state/halt/T1 prevents treating it as flat control. Its pre-T0 history is not candidate performance.
comparison.positive_review_requires: Both arms satisfy minimums, no unresolved exposure/funding/integrity faults; candidate base and stress net gain positive and maximum drawdown <=10%; base and stress total PnL differences positive; unilateral 95% lower bound of weekly paired base-return differences >0.

bootstrap.unit: UTC weekly sums including partial and zero-trade weeks

comparison.parameter_change: New version and future boundary; previous observed window consumed for new variant, never repaired into a new holdout.
comparison.weekly_return_definition: End-minus-start equity divided by start equity for each UTC week (partial weeks retained); difference candidate minus control. Bootstrap means of these paired weekly differences.
